answer: By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the reef of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
